text: No, Albert doesn't charge late fees or interest on Instant advances. If your repayment can't be collected on the due date, we may try again, and you won't be able to take another advance until the balance is repaid. If you think you'll be short, you can check your repayment date in the app or contact our support team to see what options are available. Optional fees, like the one for instant delivery, still apply to the advance itself.
